info.title: WorkMesh cptr Bridge
info.description: Read-only context, Multica work status, and routing tools. Configuration is intentionally excluded. Read-only AICP agent tools, bridged for cptr (Open WebUI Computer) tool-server registration. Skeleton bridge: requests are proxied verbatim to the AICP upstream.

post.summary: Get a live work brief for a named context
post.description: PRIMARY TOOL for questions about a project/context's status, progress, risks, issues, project resources, or current work. Pass the user's original question unchanged. The result contains live Multica work data plus Open WebUI Knowledge IDs. If knowledge_query_plan.bound is true and the question needs design, specification, domain, history, or decision evidence, then call Open WebUI's built-in query_knowledge_files with knowledge_query_plan.query and knowledge_query_plan.knowledge_ids before answering.

get.description: Use when a context name is missing, ambiguous, or the user asks what work contexts are configured.

get.summary: Get today's live work focus from Multica
get.description: Use when the user asks what to work on today, current priorities, blockers, or active work across contexts.
Use for a specific issue key/id. If context_id is known, pass it so the correct Multica workspace is selected.

get.summary: Read agent runs for a Multica issue
get.description: Use when the user asks about run history, retries, whether an agent ran, or why work may have failed. Follow with workspace_run_messages for a failed task when needed.

get.summary: Read messages/logical transcript for one Multica task run
get.description: Use after workspace_issue_runs when diagnosing a specific failed or incomplete task run.
